title: One vote: one line of _build/facts/votes/<service>.jsonl
description: Append-only log written by `facts vote`. A vote counts only when its rev equals the current rev of the fact. Allowed verdicts per lens: entail = support, partial, not-supported, unsure; currency = current, outdated, unsure; derive = support, not-supported, unsure; rederive = match, mismatch, not-found (computed by the tool from 'answer').

voter.description: label of the voting agent; must differ from the fact's author

reason.description: one or two sentences; for a negative verdict, what the quote does support

source_id.description: snapshot of a conflicting or newer statement (currency), or of the re-derived answer

quote.description: verbatim text from source_id; checked with find_quote when present

answer.description: rederive only: the value the verifier found

content.description: set by `facts vote`: facts.content_hash() of the fact at the time of the vote (claim, kind, hard, values, qualifiers, changed, change_items, derivation, volatility, and source_id, url, quote, table_header of each evidence item, plus its heading when set). A vote counts only while the fact still has this hash
